backup-not-stored: Could not store the backup. Your files are unchanged.
bulk-kind-clear-bookmarks-blurb: Permanent. The posts themselves are untouched.
bulk-kind-clear-history-blurb: Permanent. History rows are removed outright.
bulk-kind-delete-comments-blurb: Soft-deleted, so everything lands in the bin above and can be restored.
bulk-kind-delete-posts-blurb: Soft-deleted, so everything lands in the bin above and can be restored.
bulk-kind-unfollow-blurb: Permanent. Unfollowing cannot be undone from the bin.
cookie-consent-learn-aria: Learn more about our cookie policy
cookie-consent-text: We use essential cookies to run the site and privacy-friendly analytics to improve it.
cookie-consent-text-ads: We use essential cookies to run the site, privacy-friendly analytics to improve it, and advertising cookies to fund it. Choosing “Essential only” keeps the ads but stops them being personalised.
email-category-announcements-desc: Site news. On by default; people who turned announcement emails off are left out. Nobody gets more than one announcement or product email every 48 hours, or the same message twice.
email-category-product-desc: New games, apps and features. Only people who turned product news on get it. Nobody gets more than one announcement or product email every 48 hours, or the same message twice.
email-category-service-desc: Sent to everyone in the audience, whatever their email settings, with no unsubscribe link. Only for notices people must receive: a security breach, a change to the terms, an outage affecting their account. Still never sent to the same person twice.
notFound.body: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist, moved, or never did. Let’s get you back on track.
notFound.title: Page not found
offline-body: RMH Studios needs a connection for this page. Check your network and try again.
put-back-confirm: Put back the files from {{time}}? The restored backup is removed.
put-back-stale: The restored backup has been saved over, so the previous files cannot be put back.
restore-storage-full: Browser storage is full. The backup was not restored. Your current files are unchanged.
steam-gems-err-coins: You do not have enough coins.
steam-gems-err-gems: You need 100 gems for a booster pack.
steam-gems-err-held: You do not hold that many of that card.
steam-hub-err-banned: Your account cannot post right now.
steam-hub-err-input: Check the title and text, then try again.
steam-hub-err-rate: You are posting too fast. Try again later.
steam-market-err-coins: You do not have enough coins.
steam-market-err-far: That price is far above recent sales of this card.
steam-market-err-gone: That listing is no longer available.
steam-market-err-level: You must be level 3 or higher to sell.
steam-market-err-many: You have too many active listings.
steam-market-err-new: Your account must be 7 days old before you can sell.
steam-market-err-ordered: You already have a buy order for this card.
steam-market-err-orders: You have too many open buy orders.
steam-market-err-owned: You do not hold that card.
steam-market-err-price: Price must be between 10 and 5000 coins.
steam-market-err-self: You cannot buy your own listing.
steam-trade-err-friends: You can only trade with someone you follow or who follows you.
steam-trade-err-gone: That offer is no longer available.
steam-trade-err-missing: One of you no longer holds those cards.
steam-trade-err-pending: You have too many pending offers.
trash-reason-expired: The recovery window for this has passed.
trash-reason-moderated: This was removed by a moderator and cannot be restored.
trash-reason-not-deleted: This is not deleted, so there is nothing to restore.
trash-reason-not-found: This is no longer in the database — it has already been permanently deleted.
trash-reason-not-owner: This is not yours to restore.
trash-reason-parent-deleted: The post this replied to is also deleted. Restore that one first.
trash-reason-parent-missing: The post this replied to no longer exists.
